title: Null control: Kuwait SO2 vs JETS
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: Kuwait CAMS SO2 20d z-score > 1 (refinery activity, not outage) should NOT predict airline ETF moves (-); trade short JETS 2d at 1d lag [airquality.kuwait.cams_so2 -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0071)
message: Null control holds: Kuwait SO2 z>1 does not predict JETS (r=0.036, n=389; short 1d hit 51%, sharpe -1.13, actionability 0.6)

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.kuwait.cams_so2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short JETS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control passed for Kuwait SO2; test whether Kuwait CAMS NO2 20d z-score > 1 (traffic/industrial, not conflict) likewise fails to predict JETS relative to SPY; trade short JETS/SPY ratio 2d at 1d lag [airquality.kuwait.cams_no2 -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0170)
